about: A condition that cannot be evaluated makes a forbid or ask apply and a permit not apply; every erroring law is reported.
laws:
laws "conformance" version 1

law reads
  says  "reads"
  why   "Conformance."
  on    action read of Doc
  permit when principal.age > 17
  evidence watched

law open
  says  "open"
  why   "Conformance."
  on    action open of Doc
  permit
  evidence watched

law review
  says  "review"
  why   "Conformance."
  on    action open of Doc
  ask when context.missing == 1
  evidence watched

law share
  says  "share"
  why   "Conformance."
  on    action share of Doc
  permit
  evidence watched

law guard
  says  "guard"
  why   "Conformance."
  on    action share of Doc
  forbid when resource.missing == 1
  evidence watched
